description: a cone r 4, h 4 whose side face is bounded by its base circle alone, its apex left implicit — no VERTEX_LOOP, no degenerate edge — as NIST's FTC-10 writes its drill points (faces #5417, #5569, #5986 and five more): the reader walks the face as one loop wrapping a period and its checker refuses the body (L4, zero signed area), where the face wants a seam to the apex its surface closes at, as a VERTEX_LOOP's gets. Shrunk from FTC-10 (ADR-0026 §4); Open CASCADE reads it, healed, to π·16·4/3
source: written by hand for this fixture, shrunk from NIST parts (ADR-0026 §4)
